title: Weights & Biases syncs online
explanation: wandb is installed and WANDB_MODE isn't offline or disabled, so any wandb.init() call syncs runs, metrics and artifacts to the W&B service.

evidence.detail: wandb 0.18.7 installed; not disabled in the image (none of WANDB_MODE=offline|disabled|dryrun)

fix: Set WANDB_MODE=disabled (or offline) in the image environment, or remove wandb from the runtime image.
